senses.gloss: पुक्कश(स) m. (-शः- or -सः) A Chaṇḍāla, an outcaste: see पुक्कस.

पुक्कस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Low, vile.
 m. (-सः) A Chaṇḍala, or man of an
impure and degraded tribe or occupation, born of the Nishāda
by a Śūdra female.
 f. (-सी)
 1. Indigo.
 2. A bud, a blossom.
 3. A
woman of the Pukkasa tribe.
 E. पु for पुण्य purity, कु bad
(understood,) कस् to go, aff. अच्, deriv. irr. or appropriately
पुक् कुत्सतिं कसति कस-गतौ अच् पृषो० वा शः ।
